profile.headline: Full Stack Developer
profile.summary:
❖ COURSES & PROJECTS ❖

• Web Technologies
-- Designed a personal website providing personal information as well as the course overview.

• XML and Advanced Web Technologies
-- Designed several UIs using Microsoft Visual Studio to extract information from an XML document and display them in a tree view.

• Software Engineering
-- Designed a simulated ATM using Eclipse and Google Code (Group Project).
➙ Project Link: http://code.google.com/p/lloydbank/

• Parallel & Distributed Systems
-- Designed various self-hosted and web hosted service UIs using WCF.

• Game Design
-- Participated in the design process of a mock up version of the original game 'Worms' using Visual Studio XNA 4.0 (Group Project).

• Capstone
-- Participated in the development of a BlueJ Extension implementing Mercurial commands (Group Project).

-- Participated in the development of an Android application that parses through a list of tweets from Twitter for campus events (Group Project).

Specialties: 
❖ TECHNICAL SKILLS ❖

• Platforms: 
--- Windows XP, Windows Vista, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 10

• Programming Languages:
--- C#, VB.Net, Java, HTML 5, CSS, JavaScript, XML, XSLT, XPath, T-SQL

• Software: 
--- Microsoft Visual Studio 2005 - 2019, Eclipse, Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Adobe Photoshop, Clip Studio Paint

• Database Systems: 
--- Microsoft Access, Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, FileMakerPro, Oracle, DB2

• Development:
--- Integration Services (SSIS) 2005, 2008: ETL
--- 2012 SQL Server Data Tools (SSDT): ETL

positions.title: Lead Application Developer
positions.description: Confident working within an Agile environment collaborating with team members during daily Scrum meetings and story planning. Utilized SSDT to aid in the migration of data from Oracle to SQL Server by building ETLs. Collaborated with our Senior UI Designer to bring her web app mockup to life using Kendo UI controls and jQuery to manipulate DOM components. Aided in developing and kicking off several console applications and database scripts for a major business integration. Implemented front-end logic for several web applications using JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML 5, CSS, and recently ASP.NET Core MVC.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: Worked within an Agile environment, performed development work on various maintenance/defect cases, implemented unit tests using C# in Microsoft Visual Studio 2010.

positions.title: Computer Science: Teacher's Assistant
positions.description:
- Assisted students with the comprehension of various computer programming languages and skills. 
- Assisted teachers with helping students gain knowledge about programming languages and skills within the classroom.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Intern
positions.description: Worked within a Scrum environment, tested various software and hardware, documented test cases using HP Quality Center, implemented test cases for an application server using C# in Microsoft Visual Studio 2010.

positions.title: Computer Science: Work Study
positions.description: Developed several CS WoW (Computer Science Women of West Georgia) T-shirts – created several designs, researched the shirts’ likability through feedback of an audience, implemented the designs in the online virtual world, Second Life.

honors.title: Top 20 Most Appreciated Employees
honors.description: Over the years I’ve received various praises from my fellow co-workers. Back when I was working as a Standard Dev, our Senior UI Designer, emailed me privately stating she enjoyed working with me and I was easy to work with when it came to implementing the web application we were tasked with using her mock-ups as a guide for the look and feel of the application. A Senior Database Admin gave me the same praise of willingness to learn and being easy to work with when it came to building applications or implementing new features for the business. A Lead Developer looked forward to working with me on the same team after seeing the work I put into helping his team at the time recreate a Click Once Application as a web application. I was then recognized as one of the top 20 employees appreciated at our company in 2019 when a company wide survey was sent around.
honors.issuer: Issued by Acuity Brands Lighting · Oct 2019
